discrepancies.explanation: One outlet describes a near military attack, the other a near war with China.

quotes.quote: almost led to US military attack
AI almost led the US military to start a war with China

headline: AI error nearly triggered a US military strike on a Chinese ship
summary: Both reports describe an account, attributed to news sources, in which an AI error about Chinese nuclear weapon components nearly led the US military to attack a Chinese ship. One notes that military use of AI appears to be accelerating despite the incident. The outlets differ in scale of framing, one describing a near attack and the other a near war.
